descriptions.zh: 将一个条件访问策略从启用状态变为禁用状态时，策略将不再拦截，请确认您已知该操作可能导致的风险。
descriptions.en: When you change a conditional access policy from the enabled state to the disabled state, the policy no longer intercepts requests. Confirm that you are aware of the security risks that this operation may cause.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam disable-conditional-access-policy --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --conditional-access-policy-id cap_11111 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam DisableConditionalAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ConditionalAccessPolicyId cap_11111
